name: Bridge inbound: WhatsApp message to messenger chat
description:
## Context
Inbound WhatsApp events must appear inside the linked codx-junior chat, authored by the right user, and be visible live in the web UI. Thanks to `ChatManager.save_chat` emitting `chat-event` / `message-event`, no extra notification code is needed.

## Objective
`codx/junior/channels/bridge.py` → `handle_inbound(event)`.

## Steps
1. Resolve the binding: `store.find_by_external("whatsapp", event.group_id or event.wa_id)`.
   - No binding + `autocreate` enabled in settings: create a `Chat` (`mode="channel"`, `board`/`column` from settings, `users=[team sender]`, `visibility="public"` for groups) and persist the binding.
   - No binding + autocreate disabled: log and drop.
2. Sender mapping: `settings.whatsapp.user_mapping[wa_id]`, else auto-provision/lookup a `CodxUser` (`whatsapp:<wa_id>`, display name = WhatsApp push name). Outbound replies always use the configured team user.
3. Build and append the message:
   `Message(role="user", user=<mapped CdxUser username>, content=<text>, meta_data={"channel": {"provider": "whatsapp", "external_id": ..., "external_message_id": ..., "sender_wa_id": ..., "sender_name": ...}})`
   then `chat_manager.add_message(chat, message)` and `chat_manager.save_chat(chat)`.
4. Groups: prefix the content with the sender display name (`*Ana:* hola`) so a mirrored group stays readable; DMs stay unprefixed.
5. Media: `client.get_media` → reuse `ChatAttachment` limits (`MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_BYTES`, `ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_TYPES`); oversized/unsupported types become a text placeholder instead of failing the message.
6. Never create a message for events that originated from our own outbound (see `meta_data.channel` and the sent-id ledger).

## Files
- codx/junior/channels/bridge.py (new)
- codx/junior/channels/whatsapp/adapter.py (new, implements the shared adapter interface)
- codx/junior/chat_manager.py (only if a helper is missing)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A WhatsApp text message shows up in the linked chat with the mapped author and arrives live in the UI.
- [ ] Group messages are prefixed with the sender name; DMs are not.
- [ ] Image/document attachments are stored on the message within the existing size/type limits.
- [ ] Duplicate webhook delivery produces a single chat message.
- [ ] Unbound conversations with autocreate disabled are logged and dropped.
